fields.Name: T182 - API Scopes Tree and Create Dialog
fields.Description: Tests the recursive scope-tree rendering (ScopeTree + toggleExpanded/expandAll) and the parent-aware create dialog with full-path preview — a bespoke hierarchy UI unlike any generic grid.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Switch to the Admin application via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, open 'Identity & Access', and select the 'API Keys' sub-section, then click the 'Scopes' tab in the L2 tab nav. The API Scopes panel renders a hierarchical scope tree with expand/collapse toggles and 'Expand All' / 'Collapse All' controls. Click 'Expand All' (or expand a node with children) and observe the tree responds. Then click 'New Scope' to open the create dialog and verify it renders fields including Scope Name, a Parent Scope dropdown, Category, and a full-path preview. Seeing the tree respond and the create dialog render is success — do NOT save. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The 'Scopes' tab shows a hierarchical scope tree (or a valid empty state) with expand/collapse controls
Using Expand All / a node toggle changes what child scopes are visible
Clicking 'New Scope' opens a dialog with Scope Name, Parent Scope dropdown, and Category fields
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
